# AIC Egerton Chapel
A vibrant community of believers in Njoro, Kenya, dedicated to worship, spiritual growth, and serving others.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://aicegertonchapel.org/): Welcome, service times, and latest announcements.
- [About](https://aicegertonchapel.org/about.html): Our history, mission, vision, and leadership.
- [Sermons](https://aicegertonchapel.org/sermons.html): Watch or listen to past sermons.
- [Ministries](https://aicegertonchapel.org/ministries.html): Find a ministry to join.
- [Give](https://aicegertonchapel.org/give.html): Support the church through secure giving.
